sample.protocol: Uniform deterministic SHA-256 ranked unseen eligible sessions; one independently hash-ranked terminal-text proxy per session. No classifiers, predictions or old labels used for selection.

reconstruction: Download the pinned conversations.jsonl and verify source_sha256. Select its zero-based JSONL row, then messages[message_index_zero_based].content. Verify UTF-8 SHA256 against text_sha256; hash the row session_id to check session_sha256. IDs match classification-v061-public-evaluation.json. The fixed sample was selected before predictions; labels are frozen independent annotations.
